# ubiops_webhook (Resource)

Manages a UbiOps webhook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_webhook" "example" {
  project_name = "my-project"
  name         = "my-webhook"
  url          = "https://example.com/webhook"
  event        = "deployment_request_completed"
  object_type  = "deployment"
  object_name  = "my-deployment"
  enabled      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event` (String) Event that triggers the webhook
- `name` (String) Name of the webhook
- `object_name` (String) Name of deployment or pipeline for which the webhook is created
- `object_type` (String) Type of object for which the webhook is created
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project.
- `url` (String) Callback url to send event payloads to

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the webhook
- `enabled` (Boolean) Boolean value indicating whether the webhook is enabled or disabled
- `headers_json` (String, Sensitive) Request headers to use when calling the webhook
- `include_result` (Boolean) Boolean indicating whether the result of a request should be included in the webhook call. It defaults to False.
- `labels` (Map of String) Dictionary containing key/value pairs where key indicates the label and value is the corresponding value of that label
- `retry` (Boolean) Boolean value indicating whether the calls to webhook should be retried if they fail
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds on the call to webhook
- `version` (String) Name of deployment/pipeline version for which the webhook is created

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) The date and time the webhook was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the webhook (UUID)
- `last_updated` (String) The date and time the webhook was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_webhook.example my-project/my-webhook
```
